goal: Allow running transaction indexing alongside block pruning on storage-constrained nodes
Surface missing block hashes so callers can fetch pruned blocks on demand when looking up transactions
agreement: Strong concept support for allowing transaction indexing on pruned nodes
Concept approval because it greatly expands pruned node capabilities (ajtowns, arejula27, optout21)
Suggestions to clarify error details and lookup cases await author replies (arejula27, fjahr, optout21)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes the mutual exclusion between transaction indexing and block pruning
Storage-constrained node operators can index all transactions without storing full block history

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because lookups for pruned transactions return structured candidate block hashes
RPC and REST callers can automatically fetch missing pruned blocks on demand using those hashes
